findings: Revise `article.summary.text` and `article.learner.overview.text` so they describe 习 as the simplified written form of 習, used for “practice,” rather than saying 习 itself “means practice.” The cited evidence establishes practice as a meaning of 習 and its simplified counterpart, while 习 is the standardized simplified form (E1, E2, E3, X-e603a4f2b7d169374502).
